name.zh: 史黛菈请求西京宁音地狱特训
name.en: Stella asks Nene Saikyo for hell training

periods.summary: After experiencing Ouma's overwhelming power and seeing Toka fall while protecting her, Stella goes to the KOK training facility and waits for Nene. She admits that she is weak and may not reach the place promised with Ikki unless she changes. Nene agrees to train her for one week, but warns that she will not teach techniques—only beat Stella mercilessly and let her find her own answer.
periods.cause: Stella's losses to Toka and Ouma make her understand the pain of weakness for the first time.
periods.outcome: Stella disappears from the dorm for the week before Seven Stars to undergo Nene's brutal training.
periods.significance: Sets Stella's pre-tournament growth path and explains her absence before the festival begins.
